title: Core v2: a walk-forward LightGBM decision core per timeframe (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d) versus the current matrix rule
user_context: The user trades BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, TRX manually on KuCoin futures and asked for a stronger decision matrix: more indicators, market positioning data (buy vs sell volume and similar), a better AI core, and a 5-minute timeframe.
state_at_registration: Discovery-only univariate IC tables were computed (bot/data/hist_research/core_v2_discovery_ic.json, 2022-01..2024-06). No model has been fitted. No validation or holdout statistic of any v2 model has been computed or looked at.

data_sources.features_tier_A: Binance SPOT klines with taker-buy volume (live: data-api.binance.vision /api/v3/klines, Binance's public market-data host that the engine already uses; history: data.binance.vision spot archive). Price, indicators, spot order flow (taker buy vs sell), cross-asset and calendar features.
data_sources.features_kucoin_funding: KuCoin futures funding-rate history (/api/v1/contract/funding-rates), the same source live and in history.
data_sources.labels: Binance USD-M futures klines from the public archive (um_<SYM>_<tf>.npz), as in the current scorecard; KuCoin perpetual prices track them closely.
data_sources.excluded: Binance futures open interest, long/short ratios, futures taker flow, premium index and funding cannot be fetched live from this machine except through a route around Binance's restricted-location block (fapi returns 451). That route is not used. These series, order-book depth and liquidations are therefore NOT model inputs. Live positioning from OKX/KuCoin public APIs is shown on the page as display-only context and recorded going forward; it has no training history with the same definition.

features.implementation: bot/core_feats.py, one numpy code path for history and live; every window is trailing (bars <= t). The file hash at training time is written into the report.
not_used: kNN vote (discovery IC -0.1% to -2.1%; kept in the rule only)
any OKX/KuCoin substitute for Binance futures positioning
features.per_timeframe_windows: z-score windows 5m 2016, 15m 960, 1h 720, 4h 360, 1d 180 bars; ROC short/mid/long 5m 6/24/96, 15m 4/16/64, 1h 3/12/48, 4h 3/12/42, 1d 3/10/30; z-scores use the prior window only and need half of it present
features.pruning: Features may be dropped before the first fit only if they cannot be computed identically live (tail-parity test) or are constant; drops are listed in the report. No pruning after any fit.

target: For each bar i and side s: bracket.signal_trade on futures bars (entry at next open, stop 1R = engine bracket, target 1.8R, 40-bar cap, both-hit = loss), net R after 0.14% round-trip cost, clipped to [-2, 1.8]. Two regressors per timeframe: M_long and M_short predict E[net R].
model: LightGBM regressor, objective huber (alpha 1.0), learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 15, max_depth 5, min_data_in_leaf max(500, n/400) at 5m/15m, 200 at 1h, 100 at 4h; 1d num_leaves 7, min_data_in_leaf 60; feature_fraction 0.7, bagging_fraction 0.7, bagging_freq 1, lambda_l2 10, max_bin 63, deterministic, seed 42. Five coins pooled with equal total weight per coin; every second row at 5m. Early stopping on the last 15% of training rows by time (41-bar gap), patience 100, max 1500 rounds, then refit on all training rows with the best round count.
walk_forward: Refit at the start of every calendar month of the validation window (and of the holdout window only if the timeframe is adopted). Training rows: t_i <= month start - 81 bars (41-bar label purge + 40-bar embargo). Out-of-sample predictions for each month come only from that month's model.
decision_rule_fixed: long if E_L >= 0.05 and E_L - E_S >= 0.05; short if E_S >= 0.05 and E_S - E_L >= 0.05; otherwise wait. Margins {0, 0.10, 0.20} reported as sensitivity only.
trade_simulation: As decision.replay: one open trade per coin and timeframe, entry at next open, net of 0.14% (0.10% maker-entry variant reported only).
baseline: decision.replay of the current matrix rule on the same bars and window.
adopt_rule_per_timeframe_on_validation: pooled mean net R of v2 >= current rule + 0.05R, and the weekly-block bootstrap 95% CI of the difference is above 0
pooled mean net R of v2 > 0 with n >= 100 trades (1d: n >= 40); one-sided weekly-block bootstrap p-value of mean <= 0, Holm-corrected across the 5 timeframes at alpha 0.10
at least 3 of 5 coins with mean net R > 0
no single coin contributes more than 50% of total net R
holdout: Run once, only for adopted timeframes: pass if mean net R > 0 with n >= 30 (1d: n >= 20). Pass -> the matrix uses v2 for that timeframe, labelled 'passed validation and holdout, live test pending'. Fail -> the timeframe keeps the current rule; v2's view is shown only as a labelled second opinion with its own out-of-sample record.
contamination_note: The holdout window 2025-07..2026-08 overlaps the current rule's 2-year scorecard window (2024-08-31..2026-08-31) that is displayed in the UI. That scorecard describes the old rule and was not used to design v2, but the forward live ledger remains the only fully clean test.
authority: v2 never sets tradeable, never writes gates.json and is never read by the autotrader.
no_changes_after_seeing_results: features, target, model parameters, walk-forward, decision rule, windows, costs and adopt rules above are fixed
